name: GKD General Keypoint Detection
description: GKDT (General Keypoint Detection Transformer, ECCV 2026) open-world keypoints from text and/or 1-shot visual prompts via native GGML inference; multi-object mode composes the YOLO-World open-vocabulary detector.

references.text: GKDT: General Keypoint Detection Transformer (ECCV 2026): https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.00752
